notes.text: Standing orders are counted in cases. Harbour has a standing order of 9 cases every Tuesday. Orders placed by Friday noon are delivered the following Tuesday for Harbour and the following Monday for Central.
Price list: oat milk is 2.40 dollars per carton, unchanged until the end of the year. Allow 5 days between an order and its delivery.

Packaging update. From the delivery of 4 August 2026, oat milk ships in cases of 8 cartons instead of 12, because of the new recycled-board carton. Standing orders stay at the same number of cases, so the weekly number of cartons falls unless the case count is raised. Please review your case counts.
Extra deliveries on request: a second weekly delivery (Friday) can be added for branches that order more than 10 cases a week. Ask your account manager.
Harbour is delivered every Friday. Price 1.10 dollars per carton. No changes planned.
Deliveries are on Mondays. Price 14.00 dollars per kg. Bags are 1 kg. No changes planned.
